vBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2230: circular-dependency ratchet (madge --circular baseline) wired into lint

plan.title: chore(ratchets): circular-dependency ratchet (madge --circular baseline) wired into lint
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: No madge/dependency-cruiser exists in the repo and nothing stops new import cycles from appearing. The dashboard's circular ESM imports already force a dist-only run posture (Node strict ESM rejects require() of an ES module in a cycle, so tsx/source-mode fails) — a standing dev-loop tax and the root of the stale-dist incident class. This installs a shrink-only ratchet: npm run lint fails when a NEW cycle appears; a committed baseline lists today's cycles so removing one lowers the baseline. It breaks no cycle itself.
narratives.Proposal: Add madge as a devDependency. Add scripts/lint-circular-deps.sh mirroring scripts/lint-source-introspection.sh (check / --update / --regen), where the baseline scripts/circular-deps-baseline.txt holds one CANONICAL cycle per line (rotate to lexicographically-smallest member, join ' > ', sorted). Wire lint:circular into the chained npm run lint before lint:ratchet-audit, and extend scripts/lint-ratchet-audit.sh to audit the circular baseline like the eslint-any allowlist (an added cycle line needs an issue reference). Document under docs/codebase-health/A4. Cycle-breaking is explicitly follow-up work the ratchet protects.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Breaking any existing import cycle (Epic B / follow-up)
- Making the dashboard runnable via tsx/source-mode (a consequence of later cycle-breaking, not this issue)
- Applying the guard outside src/ (scripts/, packages/, dist)
- Adopting dependency-cruiser or any graph-visualization tool
- Resolving frontend path-alias imports madge cannot see (accepted under-detection)

autoDecisions.rationale: Purpose-built for --circular, clean --json cycle array, no config file needed, resolves TS via existing typescript ^5.3.2; a simple bash guard matches the A3 file-size ratchet ethos. dependency-cruiser is a heavier configured tool.

autoDecisions.summary: Scan all of src/ (.ts,.tsx), not just the dashboard.
autoDecisions.rationale: A repo-wide ratchet is strictly more valuable and mirrors the file-size guard scope; frontend alias imports madge cannot resolve are skipped (never false-positive), acceptable for a regression ratchet.

autoDecisions.summary: Baseline = one canonical cycle per line (set-of-lines semantics).
autoDecisions.rationale: A cycle is a list of files, not a single file, so the file-size '<count> <path>' shape does not fit; the eslint-any-allowlist.json set-of-lines shape (also audited by ratchet-audit via comm) does.

autoDecisions.summary: Include ratchet-audit integration in this issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: 'Same pattern as the file-size guard' — the file-size baseline IS audited by ratchet-audit; including the circular baseline keeps it honest against silent --regen inflation.

expected_outputs: madge --version prints a version and exits 0

narrative.Action: Add "madge": "^8" (current stable line) to devDependencies in package.json and run `bun install` from the workspace root to update bun.lock. Do not modify unrelated dependency versions. This adds an otherwise-unused binary; the tree stays green.

items.title: package.json devDependencies includes madge, and `node_modules/.bin/madge --version` exits 0
`bun install` updates bun.lock to include madge and preserves all other dependency versions unchanged
Add scripts/lint-circular-deps.sh guard and generate the canonical baseline

expected_outputs: check mode exits 0 and prints 'circular-deps guard passed'
scripts/circular-deps-baseline.txt exists with one canonical cycle per line, sorted

narrative.Action: Create scripts/lint-circular-deps.sh (see the PRD draft .pan/drafts/pan-2230.md for the full script) following scripts/lint-source-introspection.sh: modes check / --update / --regen. scan_current runs `node_modules/.bin/madge --circular --json --extensions ts,tsx --exclude '(\.test\.tsx?$|\.d\.ts$|/__tests__/)' src`, then a `node -e` transform canonicalizes each cycle (rotate to lexicographically-smallest member, join ' > ') and sorts. check mode fails on new cycles (current − baseline) and stale cycles (baseline − current); --update keeps baseline ∩ current (shrink-only, never adds); --regen writes the full current set. `chmod +x` the script. Generate the baseline via `--regen` and commit scripts/circular-deps-baseline.txt verbatim (do not hand-edit). Do NOT rely on madge's exit code to detect cycles — parse JSON.parse(d || '[]').

items.title: Given the committed baseline, `bash scripts/lint-circular-deps.sh` exits 0 and prints a 'circular-deps guard passed' line (FR-3)
Given a synthetic import cycle is introduced between two src files, the guard exits 1 and names the new cycle (FR-1)
Given a baselined cycle is removed from the baseline file, check mode exits 1 as stale and directs to --update; running --update removes that line and lowers the baseline (FR-2, FR-4)
scripts/circular-deps-baseline.txt contains one canonical (rotation-invariant), sorted cycle per line for the cycles madge detects under src, and the guard exits 0 against it (FR-3)
Wire lint:circular into the npm run lint chain

expected_outputs: npm run lint exits 0 and its output includes the circular-deps guard line

narrative.Action: In package.json, add "lint:circular": "bash scripts/lint-circular-deps.sh" next to the other lint:* entries, and insert `&& npm run lint:circular` into the chained `lint` script immediately BEFORE `&& npm run lint:ratchet-audit` so the ratchet audit stays last. Change only those two spots; do not reformat the rest of package.json.

items.title: `npm run lint:circular` runs scripts/lint-circular-deps.sh and exits 0
The chained `lint` script contains `npm run lint:circular` positioned before `npm run lint:ratchet-audit`, and `npm run lint` exits 0 (FR-5)
Audit the circular baseline in scripts/lint-ratchet-audit.sh

expected_outputs: audit exits 0 on the clean branch and prints 'ratchet audit passed'

narrative.Action: In scripts/lint-ratchet-audit.sh, treat scripts/circular-deps-baseline.txt like eslint-any-allowlist.json (set-of-lines). Add CIRCULAR_BASELINE="scripts/circular-deps-baseline.txt"; add a circular_at()/circular_increases_for_commit() pair mirroring allowlist_at()/allowlist_increases_for_commit() (parent vs commit via `comm -13`, prefix 'circular cycle added: '); include the circular increases in audit_commit's `increases=$(...)` block; and add CIRCULAR_BASELINE to the final `for file in "$BASELINE" "$ALLOWLIST"` loop. Result: a commit adding a cycle line to the baseline without an issue reference fails; with a reference it passes.

items.title: scripts/lint-ratchet-audit.sh includes scripts/circular-deps-baseline.txt among its audited files and exits 0 on the clean branch
Given a commit adds a new cycle line to circular-deps-baseline.txt with NO issue reference, running the audit over that range exits 1 and names the added cycle (FR-6)
Given the same added cycle line in a commit whose message contains an issue reference (e.g. PAN-2230 or #2230), the audit exits 0
Document the circular-dep guard (roadmap A4 row + A4 PRD doc)

expected_outputs: roadmap Epic A table and progress list show an A4 circular-dependency-guard entry

narrative.Action: Add an A4 row to the Epic A table in docs/CODEBASE-HEALTH-ROADMAP.md (circular-dependency ratchet — madge baseline wired into lint, PR PAN-2230) and a matching progress-list line. Create docs/codebase-health/A4-circular-dep-guard.md as a sibling of A3-file-size-guard.md: what the guard does, the --update (remove a resolved cycle, lowers baseline) and --regen (accept new cycles, requires an issue reference) workflow, and that cycle-breaking is Epic-B/follow-up work the ratchet protects.

items.title: docs/CODEBASE-HEALTH-ROADMAP.md contains an A4 row in the Epic A table and a progress-list line that names the circular-dependency guard

docs/codebase-health/A4-circular-dep-guard.md contains the exact commands to remove a resolved cycle (`bash scripts/lint-circular-deps.sh --update`) and to accept a new baseline (`--regen` plus an issue reference)
